message.Title: Generally Available: Azure Copilot Troubleshooting Agent

Body.Content:
Azure Copilot Troubleshooting Agent is now generally available. Troubleshooting Agent is a unified, built-in Azure Copilot capability that helps customers investigate and resolve operational issues faster. Available through both Azure Copilot and Support + Troubleshooting in the Azure portal, Troubleshooting Agent enables you to move from issue detection to resolution faster by bringing together troubleshooting insights, operational context, and recommended actions in a single experience. 

Learn more.
